grammar.usage:
这个句子使用了现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous Tense)，结构为：have/has been + 动词-ing。
英语解释: This tense is used to describe an action that started in the past, has continued up to the present moment, and may still be ongoing. It emphasizes the duration or the continuous nature of the action.
中文解释: 这个时态用于描述一个从过去开始，一直持续到现在，并且可能仍在继续的动作。它强调动作的持续性或过程。
在例句中，'have been keeping' 表示'保持（编织这个爱好）'这个动作从几年前开始，一直持续到现在，并且还在继续。
forms: 英语解释 : This tense is used to describe an action that started in the past, has continued up to the present moment, and may still be ongoing. It emphasizes the duration or the continuous nature of the action.

notes:
英语提示: In Zhongkao, you may need to choose between Present Perfect (have kept) and Present Perfect Continuous (have been keeping). The continuous form emphasizes the ongoing process and duration, often used with time phrases like 'for...years', 'since...', 'all day'.
中文提示: 在中考中，你需要在现在完成时（have kept）和现在完成进行时（have been keeping）之间选择。进行时形式强调动作的持续过程和时长，常与'for...years'、'since...'、'all day'等时间短语连用。

英语解释: This is a double comparative structure used to show that two things change together. It has the pattern: The + comparative adjective/adverb (clause 1), the + comparative adjective/adverb (clause 2). It means that as the first thing increases/decreases, the second thing also increases/decreases.

在例句中，'The more you practise'（你练习得越多）导致'the better you get'（你变得越好）。

英语提示: Remember the fixed structure: 'The + comparative, the + comparative'. Both parts must use the comparative form (e.g., more, better, faster). The verbs in each clause can be different. This is a common testing point for sentence pattern transformation.
中文提示: 记住固定结构：'The + 比较级, the + 比较级'。两部分都必须使用比较级形式（例如，more, better, faster）。每个从句的动词可以不同。这是句型转换的常见考点。

grammar.title: First Conditional (if + present simple, will + base verb) / 第一条件句 (if + 一般现在时, will + 动词原形)
grammar.titleEn: First Conditional (if + present simple, will + base verb) / 第一条件句 (if + 一般现在时, will + 动词原形)
grammar.usage:
这个句子使用了第一条件句 (First Conditional)，结构为：If + 主语 + 一般现在时, 主语 + will + 动词原形。
英语解释: The First Conditional is used to talk about real and possible situations in the future. The 'if' clause presents a possible condition, and the main clause presents the likely future result if that condition is met.
中文解释: 第一条件句用于谈论未来真实且可能发生的情况。'if'从句提出一个可能的条件，主句提出如果该条件满足，可能发生的未来结果。
在例句中，'If I do it wrong'（条件）是一个未来可能发生的动作，'I will have to make it all over again'（结果）是如果条件成立将会发生的结果。
forms: 英语解释 : The First Conditional is used to talk about real and possible situations in the future. The 'if' clause presents a possible condition, and the main clause presents the likely future result if that condition is met.
中文解释 : 第一条件句用于谈论未来真实且可能发生的情况。'if'从句提出一个可能的条件，主句提出如果该条件满足，可能发生的未来结果。
notes:
英语提示: Pay close attention to verb tenses! In the 'if' clause, use the Present Simple even though it refers to the future. In the main clause, use will + base verb. A common mistake is using 'will' in the 'if' clause. Also, note that 'will' can sometimes be replaced by other modals like 'may', 'might', or 'can' in the main clause to show possibility, permission, or ability.
中文提示: 密切注意动词时态！在'if'从句中，即使指的是未来，也要使用一般现在时。在主句中，使用will + 动词原形。一个常见的错误是在'if'从句中使用'will'。另外，注意在主句中，'will'有时可以被其他情态动词如'may'、'might'或'can'替代，以表示可能性、许可或能力。

grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态 (一般现在时)
grammar.usage:
这个句子的第一部分使用了被动语态 (Passive Voice)，结构为：主语 (These) + am/is/are + 过去分词 (thought) + (by...)。
英语解释: The Passive Voice is used when the focus is on the action or the object receiving the action, not on who or what is performing the action (the agent). The agent (by...) can be omitted if it is unknown or unimportant.
中文解释: 被动语态用于强调动作本身或接受动作的对象，而不是执行动作的人或物（施动者）。如果施动者未知或不重要，可以省略（by...）。
在例句中，'These (knitting and sewing) are often thought...' 强调的是'编织和缝纫'被如何看待，而不是谁这样认为。施动者（可能是'society'或'people'）被省略了。
forms: 英语解释 : The Passive Voice is used when the focus is on the action or the object receiving the action, not on who or what is performing the action (the agent). The agent (by...) can be omitted if it is unknown or unimportant.
中文解释 : 被动语态用于强调动作本身或接受动作的对象，而不是执行动作的人或物（施动者）。如果施动者未知或不重要，可以省略（by...）。
notes:
英语提示: To change an active sentence to passive: 1) Make the object of the active sentence the subject of the passive sentence. 2) Use the correct form of 'be' (am/is/are/was/were/have been etc.) + the past participle of the main verb. 3) Add 'by + agent' if needed. A common trap is using the wrong form of 'be' or the wrong past participle.
中文提示: 将主动句改为被动句：1) 将主动句的宾语变为被动句的主语。2) 使用'be'的正确形式（am/is/are/was/were/have been等）+ 主要动词的过去分词。3) 如果需要，加上'by + 施动者'。一个常见的陷阱是使用了错误的'be'形式或错误的过去分词。

grammar.usage:
这个句子的主语是动名词短语 (Gerund Phrase) 'learning to knit'。
英语解释: A gerund is the '-ing' form of a verb used as a noun. When a gerund (or a gerund phrase) is used as the subject of a sentence, it acts as the thing performing the action of the main verb. Gerunds are singular, so the main verb should be singular (e.g., 'is').

在例句中，'learning to knit'（学习编织）这个动作是句子的主语，是'is'所描述的对象（最好的事情）。

notes:

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 中文解释：现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.usage:
中文解释：现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成。它主要表示：1) 过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果（本句重点）；2) 从过去持续到现在的动作或状态。本句中，“have met”表示“遇到”这个动作发生在过去（开始锻炼后），但其结果（认识了新朋友）对现在有影响。
English Explanation: The Present Perfect Tense is formed with 'have/has + past participle'. It is mainly used to: 1) Show the present result of a past action (the focus here); 2) Describe an action that started in the past and continues to the present. In this sentence, 'have met' indicates the action of 'meeting' happened at an unspecified time in the past (after starting to exercise), and the result (knowing new friends) is relevant now.
notes:
中文提示：中考常考现在完成时与一般过去时的区别。一般过去时强调动作发生在过去某个具体时间，与现在无关。现在完成时强调过去动作对现在的影响或经验。常见时间状语有：already, yet, ever, never, just, since, for。注意不规则动词的过去分词形式。
English Tips: Zhongkao often tests the difference between Present Perfect and Simple Past. Simple Past emphasizes when a past action happened. Present Perfect emphasizes the present result or experience of a past action. Common time markers: already, yet, ever, never, just, since, for. Memorize irregular past participles.

grammar.key: Gerund as Object / 动名词作宾语
grammar.title: 中文解释：动名词是动词的-ing形式，起名词作用
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Object / 动名词作宾语
grammar.usage:
中文解释：动名词是动词的-ing形式，起名词作用。在这里，“reading”是动名词，作谓语动词“love”的宾语。许多动词后面习惯接动名词作宾语，表示一般的、习惯性的或已完成的动作。常见接动名词的动词有：enjoy, finish, avoid, practice, mind, suggest等。
English Explanation: A gerund is the -ing form of a verb that functions as a noun. Here, 'reading' is a gerund, acting as the object of the verb 'love'. Many verbs are typically followed by a gerund as their object, indicating a general, habitual, or completed action. Common verbs include: enjoy, finish, avoid, practice, mind, suggest.
notes:
中文提示：中考常考动词后接to do（不定式）和接doing（动名词）的区别。必须牢记哪些动词后固定接动名词（如：enjoy, finish, practice, mind），哪些接不定式（如：want, decide, hope），哪些两者皆可但意义不同（如：remember to do/remember doing）。“love”可以接两者，意义相近。
English Tips: Zhongkao often tests the difference between verbs followed by 'to do' (infinitive) and 'doing' (gerund). Memorize lists: verbs only with gerunds (enjoy, finish), verbs only with infinitives (want, decide), and verbs that can take both with different meanings (remember to do/remember doing). 'Love' can take both with similar meaning.

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Reason (because) / 原因状语从句 (because)
grammar.title: 中文解释：由连词“because”引导的从句叫原因状语从句，用于解释主句动作发生的原因
grammar.titleEn: Adverbial Clause of Reason (because) / 原因状语从句 (because)
grammar.usage:
中文解释：由连词“because”引导的从句叫原因状语从句，用于解释主句动作发生的原因。“because”引导的从句表示直接、明确的原因，语气强烈。从句可以放在主句之后（如本句），也可以放在主句之前（需用逗号隔开）。
English Explanation: A clause introduced by the conjunction 'because' is called an adverbial clause of reason. It explains why the action in the main clause happens. 'Because' indicates a direct and specific reason, and it is quite strong in tone. The clause can come after the main clause (as in this sentence) or before it (separated by a comma).
notes:
中文提示：中考常考原因状语从句的连接词：because, since, as, for。注意区别：because语气最强，回答“why”的直接原因；since/as语气较弱，表示显而易见或已知的原因；for是并列连词，表示补充说明的原因，不用于句首。从句要用陈述语序。
English Tips: Zhongkao often tests conjunctions for reason: because, since, as, for. Note the differences: because is strongest for direct cause; since/as are weaker for obvious reasons; for is a coordinating conjunction for supplementary reasons, not used at the beginning of a sentence. grammar.title: 中文解释：被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态 (一般现在时)
grammar.usage:
中文解释：被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者。一般现在时的被动语态结构为：am/is/are + 过去分词。本句中，主语“Books”是动作“transport”的承受者。使用被动语态时，动作的执行者（谁transport）不重要或未知，因此常被省略。这里强调书籍本身具有的“被用来传送”的特性。
English Explanation: The Passive Voice indicates that the subject is the receiver of the action. The structure for Present Simple Passive is: am/is/are + past participle. In this sentence, the subject 'Books' receives the action of 'transporting'. The Passive Voice is used when the doer of the action (who transports) is unimportant or unknown, and is often omitted. Here, it emphasizes the inherent quality of books being 'used to transport'.
notes:
中文提示：中考被动语态是重点。关键掌握不同时态的被动结构：一般现在时（am/is/are done）、一般过去时（was/were done）、现在完成时（have/has been done）、含情态动词（can/must/should be done）。做题时先判断主语和动词的关系（主动还是被动），再确定时态。注意不及物动词没有被动语态。
English Tips: Passive Voice is a key point for Zhongkao. Master the structure for different tenses: Present Simple (am/is/are done), Past Simple (was/were done), Present Perfect (have/has been done), with modals (can/must/should be done). First, decide the relationship between subject and verb (active or passive), then determine the tense. Remember intransitive verbs cannot be passive.
